data.title: Pop-Up Super PACs Spend $637 Million in 2026 Midterm Races
data.description: According to CNBC, 22 super PACs formed in the final 10 weeks before Election Day had reported roughly $637 million in independent expenditures on House and Senate races by Oct. 29, about one-sixth of all such spending in congressional races this election cycle. Republican-linked groups spent about twice as much as Democratic-linked groups. Many began spending before filing their first regular reports identifying their donors.

data.title: Russia Extends Restrictions on Most Diesel Exports Through January
data.description: Russia extended a general ban on diesel exports by producers through the end of January, while allowing some volumes to reach the global market, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: HYPE Address Closes Long Position, Cuts Exposure by $12.12 Million With $21.71 Million in Profit
data.description: An address closed its HYPE long position after reducing its exposure by about $12.12 million, with cumulative profits of about $21.71 million. According to Odaily, the address now holds no HYPE. It closed positions worth about $12.11 million at an average price of approximately $87.64. The address is 0xbf732ea04197942783e34730ed6e0f6099575d58.

data.title: Rivian and Ford Expand 3D Printing to Cut Costs and Speed Production
data.description: According to CNBC, Rivian Automotive and Ford Motor are expanding 3D printing across their manufacturing operations to reduce costs and shorten production times. Rivian has spent more than $5 million on 3D-printing machines, with materials costing about $1.7 million annually. Jared Beck, the company’s head of additive manufacturing, said the machines typically pay for themselves within a year and can cut parts-production times from weeks to days or hours. Rivian is also adding machines for printing flexible silicone parts and plans to let employees print parts on demand. Ford’s 3D-printing program has more than 200 machines, and the company expects to have labs at more than 23 plants by the end of this year.

data.title: Humans Still Do Work Behind Some AI Agents
data.description: According to CNBC, AI agents from companies including Meta and OpenAI still struggle to reliably complete tasks involving phone calls, scheduling and real-world judgment, leading some startups to bring in human contractors. Duckbill recently launched an API that lets companies building personal agents delegate tasks to workers, while Dazzle AI uses contractors when its technology flags a task it cannot handle. Dazzle CEO Marissa Mayer said current models can provide useful recommendations but may fail at complex tasks, and Duckbill CEO Meghan Joyce said human judgment remains important. Meta currently does not use humans to complete users’ Muse requests.

data.title: Norwegian Firm Has $100 Million at Stake in Mercuria-Baltic Exchange Case
data.description: A Norwegian firm has $100 million riding on Mercuria Energy Group’s case against the Baltic Exchange, according to Bloomberg. Mercuria’s lawyers presented the commodity company’s arguments this week in a packed London courtroom, where a group of Norwegian businessmen listened from the back.

data.title: Meta Forms Bipartisan Political Influence Team Ahead of 2026 U.S. Midterms
data.description: Meta has reportedly formed a bipartisan political influence team ahead of the 2026 U.S. midterm elections. According to Sina Finance, the company has already launched a political funding plan of up to $65 million, its largest political investment to date, using dedicated super PACs for bipartisan lobbying. The team and funding are aimed at countering what Meta sees as growing AI regulatory threats at the state and federal levels; the company seeks to support bipartisan candidates who favor the AI industry and technological innovation to prevent fragmented, restrictive state laws. AI deepfakes and misinformation on social media have drawn heightened public attention as the midterms approach, while the energy use and water consumption of AI data centers have prompted bipartisan local opposition in multiple areas.

data.title: OnePay Enables Direct USDC Transfers to Checking Account Balances
data.description: Walmart-owned fintech app OnePay said users can send USDC directly to their OnePay accounts, with funds automatically added to their existing checking account balance for bill payments and transfers without first converting the stablecoin through an exchange. According to Foresight News, the banking services are provided by Coastal Community Bank or Lead Bank.

data.title: Brighton's First-Half Goals Over 1.5 Odds Rise 35 Points on Polymarket
data.description:
On Polymarket, the “Over” option in the “Manchester City vs. Brighton” event’s “Brighton First-Half Goals Over 1.5” sub-market rose to 43% from 8% one hour earlier, a 35-percentage-point increase.

According to ChainCatcher, the probability was tracked by Catcher Predict.

data.title: Anthropic's Nasdaq IPO Path Faces New Headwinds as AI Spending Concerns Grow
data.description: According to CNBC, Anthropic's planned Nasdaq IPO faces a tougher market backdrop as investors question the cost and financing of the AI buildout. In its prospectus on Monday, the company disclosed a net loss of $80 billion for the first half of the year, hundreds of billions of dollars in compute commitments and more than 90 pages of risk factors. Investors are still awaiting its third-quarter financials. Microsoft lowered its capital spending forecast for the year to $170 billion from $175 billion, while Alphabet maintained guidance for up to $205 billion and Amazon reiterated its roughly $220 billion forecast. The Nasdaq Composite fell 2.9% on Friday, extending its losing streak to three weeks, its first such streak since March.

data.title: Sun Xinran's Polymarket Win Odds Against Harriet Dart Fall 65%
data.description: On Polymarket's Guangzhou Open: Sun Xinran vs. Harriet Dart market, the win probability for Sun Xinran fell to 13.5%. According to ChainCatcher, it was 78.5% one hour earlier, a 65% drop.

data.title: Machi Big Brother Cuts HYPE Long as Overall Positions Turn Slightly Profitable
data.description: Hyperbot data show that Machi Big Brother has closed all Bitcoin long positions and continued adding to a 25x leveraged Ethereum long, which now holds 2,125 ETH. According to Odaily, he is also reducing a 10x leveraged HYPE long, now down to 4,500 HYPE, while his overall positions have turned slightly profitable, with a return on investment of 0.89%.

data.title: Foundation Warns of New Wave of Phishing Emails
data.description: Bitcoin News reported on X that Foundation said attackers are sending a new wave of phishing emails through compromised domains belonging to other companies. According to Odaily, the emails are not sent from Foundation’s official domain.

data.title: New Economy: Trading Doubles in Japan
data.description: Trading in Japan has doubled, and it is now possible for foreign firms to play leading roles in restructuring key parts of the country’s business architecture, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei Issues Directive for Swift, Effective Response to Potential Enemy Threats Without Geographic Limits
data.description: According to Jin10, Iran's Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei issued instructions to senior armed forces commanders to respond swiftly and effectively to any potential enemy threat, without geographic limits.

data.title: Iran’s Supreme Leader: Iran Will Decide When and How the Conflict Ends
data.description: According to Jin10, Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei said that if the enemy launches another military or terrorist attack, Iran’s Armed Forces and people will decide when and on what terms the conflict ends.

data.title: GEOPOLITICS | Hormuz Shipping Strikes Leave US and Iran in Economic Standoff
data.description: Intermittent Iranian strikes on commercial vessels in Hormuz have left both sides facing economic pain as US President Donald Trump threatens renewed attacks against Iran, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Iran's Supreme Leader: Update Target List to Put U.S. and Israeli Assets Within Iranian Forces' Reach
data.description: According to Jin10, Iran's Tasnim News Agency reported that Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei also instructed officials to update the target list to ensure that all tangible and intangible assets of hostile U.S. and Israeli forces are within range of Iran's armed forces.

data.title: Two Missing Fishermen Found After “Enemy” Attack on Qeshm Island Fishing Boat, Iranian Media Reports
data.description: According to Jin10, Iran’s Mehr News Agency reported that two missing fishermen were found after an “enemy” attack on a fishing boat on Qeshm Island.

data.title: Microsoft Report: North Korean Hackers Use AI to Generate Dozens of Phishing Files in Minutes
data.description: Microsoft reported on October 30 that North Korean hacking groups are using AI to generate dozens of phishing files within minutes. According to PANews, three of the eight groups monitored by Microsoft have integrated AI across their attack processes, reaching the highest level in the company’s maturity model; the groups use AI to create customized PDF lures, write malicious code and impersonate people to infiltrate businesses.
